base: branche de session (EWC1 et ESN1 pour les utilitaires) ; aucun emprunt aux branches soeurs
biome: Amp Plains / Plaine Electrik (Explorateurs du Ciel), savane jaune-olive, falaises d ardoise et arbres morts foudroyes
method: textures canoniques = rendu genere REFERENCE : rip Amp_Plains_entrance_TD.png passe au generateur ; decor complet et temoin sans objets edites et recales (0, 0)

reference_da.titre: Amp Plains / Plaine Electrik (Pokemon Donjon Mystere : Explorateurs du Ciel, Amp_Plains_entrance_TD.png)

generation.prompt: Use EXACTLY the same textures, palette and pixel-art style as the reference image (Pokemon Mystery Dungeon Explorers of Sky, Amp Plains / Plaine Electrik): same muted olive-yellow savanna grass (#8A916E) with fine vertical blade texture, same cool slate-grey fractured rock cliffs and boulders (#86939C highlights, #4F5359 shadows), same dark gnarled lightning-struck dead trees (#484B52). Make a NEW, larger top-down dungeon entrance map. WIDE LANDSCAPE 4:3 (1200x896), zoomed out so the plain feels vast. Layout: the player arrives at the SOUTH (bottom edge center) through a gap between slate-grey rock formations; the left, right and bottom-side borders are closed by continuous slate-grey fractured rock walls; the central olive-yellow savanna grass plain opens wide, with 4 gnarled dark dead trees and slate-grey boulders scattered on the left and right flanks (leaving a wide, completely open central grass trail from south to north); at the NORTH, massive fractured slate-grey rock cliffs close the entire top half except for a narrow rocky gorge corridor at the top-center leading into the dungeon. No characters, no text, no UI, no border.

Same image, same framing and pixel-art style (1200x896), but remove all 4 dark gnarled dead trees and all isolated slate-grey boulders and small pebbles sitting inside the olive-yellow grass clearing, replacing them seamlessly with the surrounding olive-yellow savanna grass (#8A916E); keep the outer slate-grey rock cliff walls on the north, south, left and right and the grass clearing at the exact same pixel positions. No characters, no text, no UI, no border.

images: Game Boy Advance - Pokemon Mystery Dungeon_ Red Rescue Team - Dungeon Boss Rooms - Mt. Thunder.png
generation.prompt: Pixel-art sprite sheet on a flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF background, in the EXACT pixel-art style and palette of Pokemon Mystery Dungeon (Red Rescue Team Mt. Thunder lightning sheet and Explorers of Sky Amp Plains): crisp hard 1-pixel edges, no anti-aliasing, no glow blur, no magenta halos. Arrange 18 well-separated electric effect sprites in a clean 3 rows by 6 columns grid on pure #FF00FF magenta: Row 1 (top, 6 sprites): jagged branching vertical and diagonal yellow lightning bolts (#F8F800 bright yellow, #F8F898 pale yellow-white core, #989820 olive-gold fading edge, 1-2 pixel thick jagged branches like the 1-2-3-4 lightning bolts in the first reference). Row 2 (middle, 6 sprites): curved horizontal electric ground flash arcs and crackling static electricity arcs that hug the ground or wrap around a rock base (bright yellow #F8F800 and pale yellow-white #F8F898). Row 3 (bottom, 6 sprites): small electric spark bursts and 4-point static electricity stars in 6 animation stages from tiny spark to crackling star burst to split fading sparks. Well spaced, nothing touching, no background scenery, no text, no numbers, no border.
generation.essais: premier essai ; 17 poses extraites sur fond magenta (6 eclairs, 5 arcs/couronnes au sol, 6 poses d etincelles)

recalage.zones: temoin sans objets : herbe de la clairiere erodee de 6 px

fidelite_rip.methode: moyenne RGB par matiere, meme classifieur pixel sur le rip et sur le brut ; distance euclidienne ; seuil 35

normalization.methode: moyenne ponderee par classe (BOX), attribution exclusive par poids maximal

arcs_electriques.origine: eclairs ramifies et arcs/couronnes electriques style PMD generes sur fond magenta (electricite_poses.png, ref. Mt. Thunder et Amp Plains)

etincelles.origine: etoiles d etincelles statiques style PMD en 6 poses generees sur fond magenta (electricite_poses.png)
